title: Technology-based Eye Care Services (TECS) Compare
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the Technology-based Eye Care Services (TECS) protocol to the standard face to face ophthalmologic exam.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient at the Atlanta VA Medical Center (VAMC) New Comprehensive eye clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known acute or chronic ocular issues
